name: finance-control-multisurface
objective: Consolidate canonical financial operations/readback into the Finance Control Center and every required mobile surface, then verify the finance-only candidate end to end.
truthOwner: WLT owns financial truth; DSH composes operational context; each surface renders/submits intents only.

tasks.objective: Rebuild the existing /wlt/finance experience as one Finance Control Center over canonical WLT contracts.
tasks.currentProblem: Current finance UI is split between dashboard panels and separate inspectors, with several unimplemented tabs and legacy provider-payout actions.
tasks.requiredChange: Consolidate navigation/workspaces for command center, wallets, Cash-In, COD, destinations, payouts, batches/execution, reconciliation/exceptions, treasury, daily close, ledger/audit and provider health using existing components where valid.
tasks.targetState: Finance operators can complete every governed workflow without leaving the canonical finance area or using stale provider-payout semantics.
tasks.action: Refactor registry/view-model/controller/screens around generated/shared WLT bindings; remove provider-submit actions and preserve read-only inspectors as drill-down components.
mustNotChange: Do not duplicate backend state machines in React.
Do not create a second finance navigation truth.
Do not add unrelated analytics/catalog/marketing work.
acceptanceCriteria: Every required financial workspace has a canonical read model/action path.
Legacy provider payout action labels/states are absent from the current manual-settlement workflow.
tasks.rollback: Keep old components behind compatibility routing only until replacement readback is proven; do not restore obsolete financial semantics.

tasks.objective: Make finance navigation/actions permission-aware and replace unsafe operator interaction patterns.
tasks.currentProblem: Backend finance endpoints are permission-scoped, but UI exposure/action forms can be broader and some finance governance interactions use browser prompts or combine policy configuration with execution.
tasks.requiredChange: Bind navigation and action visibility to server-resolved finance capabilities, split policy administration from operational execution, use structured reason/evidence forms and enforce step-up/least-privilege where configured.
tasks.targetState: Unauthorized users neither see misleading finance actions nor bypass server checks; every sensitive mutation carries reason/correlation/audit context.
tasks.action: Update control-panel navigation/components and DSH finance facade while keeping backend authorization authoritative.
mustNotChange: Do not treat hidden buttons as authorization.
Do not put secrets/raw destination data into client state/logs.
Do not mix settlement policy edits into transfer execution forms.
acceptanceCriteria: No financial mutation depends on browser prompt text alone.
Forbidden object/scope requests are denied server-side and render deterministic error state.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation changes without weakening backend authorization; preserve audit requirements.

tasks.objective: Bind app-client and app-captain financial experiences to canonical Cash-In, wallet and COD readback.
tasks.currentProblem: Shared financial modules exist, but the complete target semantics across top-up, one-wallet captain balance, COD held/finalized effects and payout eligibility are not yet proven on both surfaces.
tasks.requiredChange: Use generated/shared WLT-through-DSH adapters, render server-owned states, prevent duplicate taps, handle offline/reconnect/stale reads and show ledger-backed history/correlation.
tasks.targetState: Client and captain never call providers or calculate financial truth locally; captain sees one wallet with clear available/held/history and governed payout eligibility.
tasks.action: Update only finance/wallet screens/controllers and required route bindings in the two apps.
mustNotChange: Do not modify unrelated delivery/map/catalog flows except the exact financial binding needed for order/COD readback.
Do not persist sensitive financial secrets on device.
Do not treat optimistic UI as financial success.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate Cash-In/COD action cannot create duplicate financial effect.
Offline/unknown-result UI remains pending/reconciliation-required rather than claiming success.
tasks.rollback: Surface rollback may hide new controls but cannot roll back server-posted financial facts.

tasks.objective: Bind app-partner and app-field earnings, official-wallet destination and payout experiences to canonical WLT state.
tasks.currentProblem: Partner/field financial readback exists in shared modules but destination verification/manual-settlement lifecycle is not yet proven end to end.
tasks.requiredChange: Render earnings/wallet, verified destination version/status, withdrawal eligibility, payout hold/progress and final reconciliation status from canonical APIs; destination changes submit verification intent rather than activating locally.
tasks.targetState: Partner and field actors can request eligible payout and understand blocked/verification states without any ability to mark external settlement complete.
tasks.action: Update only financial controllers/screens/shared adapters for partner and field.
mustNotChange: Do not add arbitrary provider free text outside supported catalogue semantics.
Do not expose finance-operator execution controls to stakeholder apps.
Do not calculate withdrawable amount locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Destination change returns to unverified state.
Payout request is limited by server eligibility and verified destination.
Completed state appears only after canonical reconciliation completion.
tasks.rollback: Rollback UI only; preserve submitted destination versions, holds and audit history on server.

tasks.objective: Run candidate-bound finance-only verification across contracts, boundaries, runtime, security, E2E and visual readback.
tasks.currentProblem: Static correctness is insufficient for money movement and this package creation environment cannot execute runtime/database/visual checks.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute the registered WLT tests/guards, control-panel checks, affected checks, financial simulator scenarios, cross-surface E2E and security/visual scenarios on the same resulting SHA; record limitations explicitly.
tasks.targetState: No unit closes on text review alone; every claimed financial outcome has code/data/runtime/readback evidence proportional to risk.
tasks.action: Use current repository scripts and add focused tests only where an invariant lacks coverage; do not expand into unrelated full-repository remediation.
mustNotChange: Do not claim production provider verification without real provider access.
Do not close with skipped critical financial checks.
Do not fix unrelated failures inside this package; classify them with reopen trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: All required unit checks pass on one candidate SHA.
Five surfaces have direct verified financial readback or evidenced non-participation for each journey.
tasks.rollback: If release verification fails, keep candidate unclosed and roll forward focused fixes; never revert by changing ledger truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: Final verification/release-readiness commit only after all prior units are complete.
